livingCosts.notes: UNM 'Cost of Living in Semenyih' page (undated, read 2026-09-30), range midpoints. Housing: on-campus accommodation RM550-RM1,200 per month including water, electricity and WiFi (off-campus RM300-RM900 excluding bills). Food: RM500-RM700 per month. Transport: UNM runs free shuttle buses to Kajang KTM/MRT, TBS and the KL campus, so no regular transport cost is listed (airport taxi RM70-RM100 excluded). Personal: phone bill RM30-RM70 per month; laundry RM4.50 per wash/dry and movies RM15 are not budgeted. 10 months = two semesters (September-June).

programmes.name: BSc (Hons) Computer Science
programmes.notes: International annual tuition for the 2027 intake (fees page: 'effective from January 2027'); 3-year programme. UNM fixes the fee at the year of entry for the whole programme. Excludes the 6% SST charged to non-Malaysians since 1 July 2025. One-off = international application fee RM424 (incl. SST) + undergraduate visa processing fee RM3,900 (EMGS/Immigration, includes first-year i-Kad and medical insurance); RM2,000 course deposit and RM2,000 visa deposit excluded as refundable/credited. 2026 = September 2026 intake fee on the course page.
